source_snapshot: Exact reviewed working-tree hashes, including coordinator-owned uncommitted fixes. This report does not approve a built/installed package.
scope: Fixed Connect CLI bridge/marker checks, immutable task/session/account binding and Continue/expiry behavior.
Conditional managed Calendar tool and private tool-session bridge.
Owned subprocess transport, Stop/in-flight reads and grant cleanup.
Current-operation-only router SQLite snapshots/restoration, matching Secret Service key records and recovery admission.

findings_fixed.issue: Consumer speech startup/reconnect briefing included raw titles of private assistant tasks.
findings_fixed.reproduction: A synthetic selected-account task was redacted by task_summary but its unique private title appeared in briefing().
findings_fixed.fix: Private task titles use a generic label in briefing; owning MVP regression verifies actual fake-provider config and reconnect briefing retain no private marker.

findings_fixed.issue: Stop did not immediately revoke a known account session and an awaited Calendar read could return private content after Stop.
findings_fixed.reproduction: Real VoiceService/TaskManager with a deferred synthetic read returned state=stopping, zero revokes at cancel, and private result after cancel.
findings_fixed.fix: Managed Stop marks stopping before external awaits, revokes known session before client.stop and never falls back to a consumer client. Account tool return rechecks task state, attempt and persisted session and withholds changed/stopped results.
findings_fixed.independent_retest: Updated assistant suite passes the actual service/manager deferred-read and Stop regression.

findings_fixed.issue: A newly created Connect grant survived local task-persistence failure without a revoke attempt.
findings_fixed.reproduction: Injected store.update disk-full failure produced only a create call and no revoke.
findings_fixed.fix: Validation/persistence failure revokes a well-formed returned session ID, preserves the original error and records cleanup-needed when storage permits.
findings_fixed.independent_retest: Updated assistant suite verifies create/revoke on persistence failure.

findings_fixed.issue: A single StreamReader.read call discarded subsequent CLI output chunks and rejected otherwise valid JSON.
findings_fixed.reproduction: A real synthetic executable emitted a valid JSON response in two flushed chunks; the bridge returned MANAGED_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.
findings_fixed.fix: Bounded chunk loop reads through EOF, rejects oversized totals and kills/reaps the owned child on failure.
findings_fixed.independent_retest: Updated assistant suite covers split small/near-limit JSON and oversized owned-process cleanup.

findings_fixed.issue: Preparation failure before maintenance-marker creation closed admission while status still advertised ready.
findings_fixed.reproduction: prepare_recovery({}) returned RECOVERY_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED with no marker, admission=false, status.ready=true and rejected acquire.
findings_fixed.fix: Artifact identity validation precedes admission closure. Snapshot failure without a durable marker restores previous admission after shutdown; other in-memory closure is represented as maintenance/not-ready.
findings_fixed.independent_retest: 28 FreeAI tests passed including the new preparation/admission regression.

additional_review: Malformed non-dict Connect errors now normalize to VoiceError so cleanup accounting sees the failure; no private-content disclosure was demonstrated from the former AttributeError.

The new assistant_admission callback checks existing/installed router maintenance before persisting a new task and before queued/continued grant creation. This does not replace the unfinished privileged installer quiescence/paired-artifact contract.

Model tool parameters cannot choose a Connect session ID, operation, endpoint or method. The host supplies immutable request/task/policy/session fields and Connect rechecks exact account authorization.

Session expiry is checked without replacement; TaskStore refuses changing an existing connect_session. Completed/cancelled/stopping sessions are revoked; failed/interrupted work retains only its original bounded session for explicit Continue.
The installed accepted managed-Connect gate was observed unavailable. Source tests use synthetic bridge/marker dependencies and do not enable that installed capability.

evidence_distinctions.recovery_tests: Actual temporary SQLite/WAL databases, real Node AES-GCM operations and actual owned synthetic processes where applicable; key-store responses are fakes.
evidence_distinctions.account_tests: Synthetic grants, account payloads and CLI processes; no Composio or Groq account request.
evidence_distinctions.consumer_speech_tests: Fake providers and synthetic content; no microphone/speaker proof.
evidence_distinctions.private_secret_service: Coordinator reports a separate actual disposable GNOME Secret Service probe using fake keys, source committed c4098a60. This reviewer inspected its role/source provenance but did not independently rerun that backend probe or inspect real host credentials.
evidence_distinctions.prior_hermes_proof: Earlier actual installed Hermes Runs proof used synthetic inference and three workspace tools. The new account-specific end-to-end live path is not accepted by that prior proof.

remaining_gates: A reviewed root-owned managed Connect marker and exact accepted packaged source are not installed/accepted. capabilities output alone is insufficient.
Privileged package installation/update remains blocked pending independently reviewed quiescence and paired signed artifacts. User-owned snapshot receipts are not privileged installation approval.
Full historical database/package rollback is deliberately unavailable; only the current prepared stopped operation can restore. Package downgrade compatibility remains unaccepted.
Live exact-account owner/scope evidence, selected read, provider/local revoke/disconnect and user privacy UI require direct acceptance.
Live Groq/free-plan behavior, complete credential/package recovery, clean guest, Lenovo and physical audio remain open.
This is a scoped source review, not an exhaustive audit or release approval; changed source/artifact inputs invalidate affected evidence.
